caption: The drawing depicts a tall, ornate vessel resembling a pitcher or ewer, standing upright on a square pedestal base. The vessel has an elongated, urn-like body with a prominent, narrow neck that flares slightly at the top. The top of the vessel is fitted with a detailed, domed lid that has a small finial at its peak. The spout is wide and curves gently outward from the upper portion of the neck. At the opposite side, an arched handle attaches to both the neck and the body; the upper portion of the handle appears textured or shaded more darkly than the rest of the vessel. The handle also has a straight section that seems to be wrapped or constructed differently, possibly indicating a different material, ending before attaching to the body. The vessel is decorated with a beaded or dotted border around the transitions between the neck, body, and base. The drawing is rendered entirely in shades of grey and black, using pencil or graphite on a plain, light background. At the bottom right corner, there is a small linear scale marked in inches for reference.
title: Silver Hot Water Pot
